plain: Honest and open; innocent and without tricks

webster.text: Open; frank; fair; candid; free from reserve, disguise, equivocation or dissimulation; used of persons or things.

more.text: Noble; generous; as an ingenuous ardor or zeal; ingenuous detestation of falsehood.
Of honorable extraction; freeborn; as ingenuous blood or birth.

example.quote: He would never be able to imagine, while any source of information remained unexplored, that it was nothing more than an experiment upon the public credulity, dictated either by a deliberate intention to deceive, or by the overflowings of a zeal too intemperate to be ingenuous.
